other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leakage via Stitched OOF Features
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates out-of-fold PCA and ICA features in a cross-validation loop and appends them to the dataset. In a subsequent cross-validation loop using the identical folds, these features are used for training base models. This causes data leakage because the OOF features for the training folds were generated using unsupervised models (PCA/ICA/Scaler) fit on data that included the validation fold of the current loop.

summary: The solution is highly advanced, utilizing custom chemoinformatic feature engineering, a diverse set of models (including a custom PyTorch Tabular ResNet), and rank-based weighted ensembling. However, there are two moderate data leakage issues: computing the imputation median on the entire training set prior to cross-validation, and an unsupervised feature leakage where out-of-fold PCA/ICA features are incorrectly used as training features in a subsequent CV loop with identical folds.
